notes:
Background: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B). Building AI-first search + conversational UX on top of product docs and support threads. Team: 2 PMs, 3 ML eng, infra (2), product eng (6). Ran Hosted API trial Jan-Feb 2026.

Hosted trial summary (observed):
- Duration: 2026-01-18 -> 2026-02-28 (prod-sim P0 traffic + internal beta).
- Avg QPS (prod-sim): 38 qps (10-peak minutes 65 qps).
- Peak concurrent inferences: 18 (observed during morning syncs).
- Token mix (sampled): avg prompt tokens 120, avg completion tokens 420; 78% of requests are short-chat (<=200 res tokens), 22% long-form summarization (400-2k tokens).
- P95 latency (Hosted API, default instance): 320ms for chat flows (streaming), 900-1200ms for long summarization (non-streamed).
- Costs: trial token spend ~ $9.6k over 6 weeks; cost sensitivity high — looking for 2-3x reduction to justify Dedicated.
- Failure modes: transient 429s at peak sustained traffic for 6-7 min windows; served by retries in client which increased tail.

Decision path and ask:
- Positive on Redwood API ergonomics and SDKs; want Dedicated for predictable throughput + lower per-token unit costs.
- Key asks for Dedicated: committed QPS pricing, concurrency guarantees, regional residency (US only), and SSO/SAML + audit logging.
- Want dedicated-sizing workshop to validate GPU counts and autoscale policy before legal/finance signoff.

POC / Dedicated sizing notes (what they'd like):
- Target steady-state qps: 35 qps (business baseline).
- Target burst qps: up to 80 qps for 10 min windows (marketing campaigns).
- Target p95 latency SLO: <=400ms for chat; <=1s for summarization (with streaming where possible).
- Token forecast model: 2.4M prompt tokens / month, 8.4M completion tokens / month (current beta extrapolated to 10k MAU).
- Expected avg concurrency: 12-20 active inferences (holds KV cache hot).
- Desired autoscale: maintain at least 2x headroom for cache warmups; prefer horizontal scaling with warm instances.
- Prefer support for quantized model variants for cost savings (willing to accept small quality delta).

Commercials / Pricing talk:
- Looking for committed capacity discount (monthly) in exchange for 12-mo commit. Initial internal budget band: $10k-$25k/month.
- Procurement wants per-GPU-equivalent pricing + egress, clear overage rules.

Security / Compliance:
- Completed initial security questionnaire (see drive doc). Next: provide SAML metadata and SOC2 audit report. KMS integration required for secrets at rest.
- Data residency: US-east preferred; legal prefers no cross-region replication without approval.

Communication snippets and quotes:
- "SDK was straightforward; biggest lift was reworking client retry logic for tail 429s." — engineering lead (Aaron G.)
- "We need predictable latency for support-agent flows, can't have noisy tails during enterprise demos." — PM (Nina R.)

Next steps (immediate):
1) Dedicated-sizing workshop (30-60m) with infra + Redwood SE — request dates week of 2026-03-15.
2) Redwood to produce committed-capacity pricing deck + example invoice line items.
3) Security: Redwood to share SOC2 + KMS integration examples; SlateBridge to provide SAML metadata.
4) Run 48h high-load POC on Dedicated (synthetic peaks) — success criteria: no 429s at 80 qps sustained 10m, p95 chat <=400ms.

Open questions / internal notes:
- Confirm whether KV cache warmup can be snapshot-restored to reduce cold-start tail.
- Determine model variant used in Dedicated (base vs quantized) and regression monitoring thresholds.
- Clarify egress billing for cross-region fallbacks.
